superseded_diagnostic_attempts.reason: Phase-only teardown labels included subsequent renderer initialization. Repaired with separate transition labels and independently checked held-window endpoints.

limitations: Public wgpu IDs and vacant slots are not total native or queued/in-flight resource accounting.
Registry element sizes are not GPU payload bytes; no process/GPU resource budget is approved here.
The reporting instance remains alive during teardown; a rebuilt renderer uses a new instance.
Non-idle frames are forced completed offscreen work, not physical presentation or native event-driven cadence.
Synthetic fixture destruction is not a real frontend process restart or persistent-session reconnect.
No installed sessions or user terminal contents were accessed.
Short churn neither proves nor disproves the multi-day issue 297.
Historical pre-registry observations retain their original source and executable identities.
